protected.btn_RefreshNhapTuSanXuat.OnSelect:
=Refresh('QLK List Production Receipts');
Refresh('QLK List Production Receipt Details');
protected.gal_NhapTuSanXuat.Items:
=SortByColumns(
        Filter(
            'QLK List Production Receipts',
            PlantCode = varUserInPlant.PlantCode,
            IsBlank(txt_SearchNhapTuSanXuat.Text) || StartsWith(ReceiptCode, txt_SearchNhapTuSanXuat.Text),
            IsBlank(DatePicker1.SelectedDate) ||  ReceiptDate >= DatePicker1.SelectedDate,
            IsBlank(cbo_FilterProductTypeNhapTuSanXuat_2.Selected) || ProductCategoryCode = cbo_FilterProductTypeNhapTuSanXuat_2.Selected.ProductCategoryCode
        ),
        "Created",
        SortOrder.Descending
    )
protected.lbl_LoaiSanPhamNhap_Row.Text:
=With(
    {_cat: LookUp(col_ProductCategories, ProductCategoryCode = ThisItem.ProductCategoryCode)},
    If(
        scrNhapTuSanXuat.Size = 1,
        "Loại sản phẩm: " & _cat.ProductCategoryNameVI,
        _cat.ProductCategoryNameVI
    )
)
protected.btn_DeleteNhapTuSanXuat.Visible:
=ThisItem.StatusCode = Index(col_WorkflowStatus,1).StatusCode &&
//ThisItem.'Created By'.Email = varCurrentUser.G_Email         &&
(varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,15).RoleCode       || // SHIFT_LEADER  - Trưởng ca
varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,6).RoleCode         || // PROD_STAT     - Thống kê sản xuất
varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,12).RoleCode        || // PROD_ASST     - Trợ lý sản xuất
varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,9).RoleCode)            // VHSX_HO       - VHSX HO
protected.btn_DeleteNhapTuSanXuat_1.Visible:
=ThisItem.StatusCode = Index(col_WorkflowStatus,1).StatusCode &&
//ThisItem.'Created By'.Email = varCurrentUser.G_Email         &&
(varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,15).RoleCode       || // SHIFT_LEADER  - Trưởng ca
varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,6).RoleCode         || // PROD_STAT     - Thống kê sản xuất
varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,12).RoleCode        || // PROD_ASST     - Trợ lý sản xuất
varUserInPlant.Role = Index(col_RoleUser,9).RoleCode)            // VHSX_HO       - VHSX HO
